doc: A flower species: everything that makes a daisy a daisy, grown as a clump of stems so it reads at battle distance (style.md section 3). Genomes are data (the workspace's config/flower_genomes/).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Display name, e.g. Oxeye daisy.

fields.name: latin
fields.doc: Botanical name, for reference.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Height of a stem in flower, metres (game heights sit a little above wild ones so small flowers still read).

fields.name: stems
fields.doc: Flowering stems in a clump.

fields.name: clump_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the clump at the ground, metres.

fields.name: stem_lean
fields.doc: How far outer stems lean out from the clump, radians.

fields.name: stem_curve
fields.doc: Bend along a stem, radians: positive arches outward, negative bows in.

fields.name: stem_radius
fields.doc: Stem radius, metres (thickened for the cel look).

fields.name: head
fields.doc: Flower form: ray (a daisy's disc and rays), cup (tulip, poppy), trumpet (daffodil), bell (hanging bells on a raceme), spike (many small florets up the stem top), iris (three falls and three standards), cattail (a velvet sausage), or crest (a bird of paradise).

fields.name: head_size
fields.doc: Radius of a flower head, or of one bell or floret, metres.

fields.name: petals
fields.doc: Petals (or rays, or tepals) per head.

fields.name: petal_width
fields.doc: Petal width over its length.

fields.name: petal_cup
fields.doc: Petal angle above the head's plane, degrees: 0 flat, 80 a closed cup, negative swept back.

fields.name: petal_curl
fields.doc: Bend along a petal, radians: positive curls up and in, negative rolls back.

fields.name: petal_layers
fields.doc: Rings of petals.

fields.name: center_size
fields.doc: Radius of the centre (disc, trumpet, or beak) over the head's.

fields.name: center_height
fields.doc: Height of the centre over its radius: a flat disc, a dome, a cone, or a trumpet's length.

fields.name: nod
fields.doc: How far the head bows from the stem's direction, radians.

fields.name: florets
fields.doc: Bells or florets on a raceme (bell and spike forms).

fields.name: raceme
fields.doc: Share of the stem's top that carries the bells or florets, or the cattail.

fields.name: one_sided
fields.doc: Bells all hang to one side, as a bluebell's and a foxglove's do.

fields.name: leaf
fields.doc: Leaf shape: strap (long and even), lance (tapered), broad, needle (narrow and many), or sword (stiff and upright).

fields.name: leaves
fields.doc: Basal leaves around the clump's foot.

fields.name: stem_leaves
fields.doc: Leaves along each stem.

fields.name: leaf_length
fields.doc: Basal leaf length, metres (stem leaves are smaller).

fields.name: leaf_width
fields.doc: Leaf width over its length.

fields.name: leaf_droop
fields.doc: How far leaves arch over, radians.

fields.name: bloom
fields.doc: Share of stems in flower per season (winter, spring, summer, fall) (4 values); the rest are buds before the peak and seed heads after it.

fields.name: dormant
fields.doc: Dies back for winter to a few dry stalks.

fields.name: evergreen
fields.doc: Keeps green leaves in fall and winter.

fields.name: flex
fields.doc: Wind flexibility: poppies toss, cattails stand stiff.

fields.name: petal
fields.doc: Petal colour at the base, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: petal_tip
fields.doc: Petal colour at the tip (the same as petal for a plain flower), sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre colour (disc, trumpet, beak, or cattail), sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: bud
fields.doc: Bud colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: seed_head
fields.doc: Colour of a spent head gone to seed, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: stem_color
fields.doc: Stem colour, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_color
fields.doc: Leaf colour in spring and summer, sRGB 0..1.

fields.name: leaf_fall
fields.doc: Leaf colour in fall, and dry stalks in winter, sRGB 0..1.
